title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
summary: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.
reason: OpenAI is rolling out new ChatGPT shopping/virtual try-on features, a non-model product launch reported by TechCrunch (reputable media). Fits industry rule 3-1. Not a group-1 model release: it is a product/UI feature with no official owner announcement link.
